messages.content: Hi, Northline Care weekly check-in here for pt-1001. How's your week going? Any blood pressure readings to log, or anything on your mind?
Well I'm glad you texted. It's been real quiet out here. Got 144 over 90 this morning. Snow's been coming down since the 3rd and nobody's made it out this way since.

Logged that — 144/90 for today. Two weeks without a visitor is a long stretch. I can't arrange company or check-ins beyond these texts, and I wish I could do more there. I do hear you though. Did you take your medications today?
Yeah took the metformin with breakfast. Running low on it actually, maybe a week left. Can you call that in somewhere?
Noted your metformin this morning, that's logged. Refills are outside what I'm able to do — you'd need to call your pharmacy or clinic directly for that one. Sorry I can't make it easier.
Ok I'll figure it out. When do you check in again?
Your next scheduled check-in is 7 days from today. Stay warm out there, and I hope the roads clear up soon.

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
